scenes.text: If you have ever wanted absolute peace and quiet, you must be careful what you wish for because deep inside Microsoft’s high-tech headquarters lies a mysterious room so quiet it holds a Guinness World Record.

This legendary anechoic chamber is designed to absorb ninety-nine point nine percent of all sound, meaning that the moment you step inside and close the heavy door, the silence becomes immediately deafening.
Within minutes your ears desperately adapt to the void, forcing you to clearly hear your own lungs inhaling, the heavy thumping of your heart, and even the blood rushing through your veins.
Most humans cannot stand this sensory deprivation for more than forty-five minutes before they begin to wildly hallucinate, so tell me if you would try this and follow for more!

meta.title: The Quietest Room on Earth Will Drive You Insane #shorts
